text:
ops-bot: Incident created — canary slice reporting sustained queue backlog and tail latency spike after deploy flag flip. auto-tags: runtime, canary, latency
sam: p50 ok, but p95/p99 climbing fast. dashboard shows queue_len -> 400 and kernel_fallback_rate increasing
alyssa: which rollout? I saw a small canary earlier
cheng: rolled out feature flag enable_dynamic_kernel at 3164320995 to 10% canary. telemetry shows degraded within ~25s
maria: customer impact: a handful of requests timed out for a few large clients on dedicated slices; support already has 2 tickets
sam: grabbing logs from one affected runtime pod (pod-73):
```
{"error":"kernel fallback","eviction_count":42,"batch_queue_len":512}
```
dmitri: batcher is collapsing to tiny batches, kv-cache thrash; fallback to CPU kernels + frequent evictions
alyssa: agree this looks like bad kernel selection. we should flip the kill-switch for the flag now
cheng: toggling flag -> false (ack) at 3164321120. Can someone confirm traffic shift?
ops-bot: Flag update detected: enable_dynamic_kernel=false by cheng at 3164321120
sam: metrics: tail latency dropping, queue_len halved within 30s, but a few sessions still in long queues
maria: initiating rollback for the release tag that contained the flag change — deploy-bot kicking off rollback
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollback start for release/2026-03-15-0f9 at 3164321145
alyssa: routing mitigation — divert canary traffic to stable model variant until kernel selector is patched
dmitri: quick root-cause assessment: under high sequence-length variance heuristics picked quantized kernels that don't handle long-context batching well; causes eviction storms
cheng: temporary mitigation checklist to include in postmortem:
- flip kill-switch (done 3164321120)
- rollback started 3164321145
- diversion to stable variant 3164321180
- capture traces and KV eviction logs
- notify CSE/support and update status page
sam: confirm rollback completed with no new kernel_fallback alerts in last 5 minutes?
ops-bot: Alert summary: kernel_fallback_rate -> normalized, batch_queue_len trending to baseline
oncall-rotation: taking handoff from sam. I'll run the smoke suite, validate throughput, and coordinate comms to affected customers
maria: drafting status.redwood.ai update and support blurb now. will include mitigation steps and expected ETA for hotfix
alyssa: assigning dmitri + cheng to own kernel-selection fix and PR. aim: hotfix + canary guarded behind explicit affinity check by EOD
dmitri: acknowledged — will open PR and include regression test against long-seq batching pattern
maria: support notes: 3 timeouts, 4 high-latency reports, 1 internal degradation alert. No data exfil or security issues
sam: reminder: preserve perf traces and full eviction logs for postmortem before log pruning
alyssa: follow-up plan: postmortem with rollout checklist updates and a clearer kill-switch runbook; also add a preflight perf test for kernel selection heuristics
oncall-rotation: will keep page open for 30m after green, then transition to postmortem writeup
ops-bot: Incident updated to SEV2 — postmortem required
ops-bot: Incident auto-closed at 3164321450 (first 30m post-stabilization). Please file postmortem and link this thread.
